SELECT PLAN_ID AS planId, PLAN_NAME AS planName, PRICE AS price, DESCRIPTION AS description, BILLING_CYCLE AS billingCycle FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_UNIVERSITY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO UNIVERSITY ( UNIV_ID, UNIV_NAME, SIDO, ADDRESS, SCHOOL_PHONE, HOMEPAGE ) VALUES ( #{univId}, #{univName}, #{sido}, #{address}, #{schoolPhone}, #{homepage} )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTIONS ( SUBSCRIPTION_ID, PLAN_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, STARTED_AT, NEXT_BILLING_AT, STATUS, ENDED_AT ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionId}, #{planId}, #{billingKeyId}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{startedAt}, #{nextBillingAt}, #{status}, #{endedAt} )

SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, PAID_AT, FAIL_REASON, AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{univId}, #{memberId}, #{billingKeyId}, #{status}, #{merchantUid}, #{portonePaymentId}, #{paidAt}, #{failReason}, #{amount} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND ENDED_AT IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = S.UNIV_ID WHERE U.UNIV_NAME = #{univName} AND S.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID AS paymentHistoryId, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AS subscriptionId, H.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, H.UNIV_ID AS univId, S.PLAN_ID AS planId, H.MERCHANT_UID AS merchantUid, H.AMOUNT AS amount, H.STATUS AS paymentStatus, S.STATUS AS subscriptionStatus FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID WHERE H.MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET STATUS = 'PAID', PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID = #{portonePaymentId}, PAID_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'
UPDATE MEMBER SET UNIV_ID = #{univId}, ROLE = 'ADM' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
